entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to add the informant as Opposite Party No.2 in the instant quashing application.
3. Permission is accorded.

4. Issue notice to the newly added Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 27.09.2023, failing which the quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
5.
In the meantime, the order dated 10.02.2016 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Bagaha, West Champaran in Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No. 7939 of 2017(2) dt.19-09-2023 connection with Ramnagar P.S. Case No. 82 of 2008, whereby cognizance has been taken against the petitioner under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code, shall remain stayed as it has been submitted that the petitioner is a government servant and on account of dispute relating to contract, he came to be implicated in the present case.
